transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm just having some issues at work. I keep starting follow-up items after audits... or mentorship events. I always mean to finish them, but... then days later, I'll find out that the final email, or a review note, or some form never actually got done. So... I figured I should make an appointment.
Have you had trouble finishing tasks like this since childhood?

I guess so, yeah. Um... even back in elementary school, my report cards usually said I was bright, but... that I'd lose assignments or rush past small details. And talk out of turn, or need reminders to finish my work. My mother actually still jokes about it. She says I could ace a test but completely forget about the project sitting right in my backpack. So... yes.
Do these kinds of problems with finishing tasks or missing details happen outside of work too?

Yeah, I suppose so. Um... at work, it's gotten to the point where a client review was actually affected. I'm just... I'm a bit worried people are starting to question if I can handle the promotion I'm up for. And... well, at home, my husband has basically had to take over paying the bills and managing things I said I'd do. He just... he feels like he can't really count on me to actually get them done. So, yes.
When you're not at work, do you still have the same trouble finishing things or keeping track of details?
Um... I mean, like I just mentioned, yes. It happens at home, too. With the bills and... the things my husband had to take over. I don't really know what else to add to that, but... yeah.
Do you often feel restless or like you have a hard time sitting still?

I suppose so... yes. It's... well, sitting still for a long review, it just feels... physically uncomfortable. It's almost like this pressure starts building inside me, and I just... I need to stand up. I'll walk to the printer or just... find some reason to move around. So, yes.
Are you often easily distracted by things going on around you?

I suppose so... yes. If I'm trying to review an audit file, just... a Slack ping or someone talking outside my office can pull me completely off track. Or even just... a random thought about my marathon training. So, yes.
Have these attention and follow-through problems caused serious problems for you at work or at home?

I mean... yes. It's... a bit hard to admit, but yes. At work... some mistakes and, um, just not following up on things... it actually affected a client review recently. I'm starting to worry they're questioning if I can even handle my promotion. And at home... well, I mentioned the bills earlier. My husband just had to take all that over, along with other commitments I agreed to... just because he can't really rely on me to actually finish them. So... yeah. It's a problem.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No... not really. I mean, I get frustrated sometimes, but... I wouldn't say I'm depressed.
Do you often find yourself worrying excessively?
Not really. I mean... I worry about my job sometimes, like I said, but... no, not excessively.
